university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology
program_name: Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours) in Interactive Software Technology

fees.notes: TAR UMT official programme page: estimated total international fees RM76,000 (inclusive of 6% SST). Source: https://focs.tarc.edu.my/programmes/bachelor-degree/bachelor-in-computer-science-honours-interactive-software-technology (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: (1) STPM - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (2) A Level - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects (4) Other IHL : Foundation relevant accredited by MQA (5) Relevant Diploma (with minimum CGPA 2.5000)^ AND SPM Credit in Mathematics/O Level Grade C in Mathematics/ UEC Grade B in one mathematics subject (6) TAR UC - Foundation in Computing (Track A) OR Relevant Diploma (with minimum CGPA 2.5000)^ Compulsory subjects: i) (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Credit in Additional Mathematics OR O Level Grade C in Mathematics-Additional OR UEC Grade B in one mathematics subject ii) (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Pass/ O Level Grade E (Pass)/ UEC Grade C in English Language* OR (1) STPM - Grade C in one Mathematics and one science/ICT subject (Science Stream) (2) A Level - Grade C in one Mathematics and one science/ICT subject Compulsory subjects: (1), and (2) must include SPM Pass/ O Level Grade E (Pass)/ UEC Grade C in English Language* OR (1) STPM - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (2) A Level - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects Compulsory Subjects: i) (1), (2), and (3) must include SPM Credit in Mathematics and one science/technology/engineering subject OR O Level Grade C in Mathematics and one science/technology/engineering subject ii) (1), (2), and (3) must include SPM Pass/ O Level Grade E (Pass)/ UEC Grade C in English Language* iii) (1), (2), and (3) must include Grade C in AMMS0204 Mathematics conducted by TAR UC ^ Graduates with CGPA 2.0001 - 2.4999 are required to sit and pass a Qualifying Test. *Grade C and above in AELE0364 English Language conducted by TAR UC is accepted as having fulfilled the English Language requirement for applicants who fail English Language at SPM/O Level/UEC. Note: a) Students without a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu are required to pass Bahasa Kebangsaan A before the award of Bachelor Degree. b) TAR UC Diploma will be accepted on credit transfer into Bachelor Degree programmes. c) Equivalent qualifications/qualifications from other Institution of Higher Learning (IHL) will be considered on a case-by-case basis. d) Subject to the Ministry of Higher Education latest requirements.
